title: OpenKYCAML camt.053 KYC Audit Profile
description: Profile for embedding OpenKYCAML audit trail and data-retention evidence inside an ISO 20022 camt.053 BkToCstmrStmt (Bank-to-Customer Statement) message. Supports AMLR Article 56 five-year record-keeping and FATF Recommendation 11.

profile.description: A bank issues a periodic statement to a corporate customer. The statement includes the KYC/AML audit trail for transactions in the statement period, embedded in the KYCAMLEnvelope inside <SplmtryData>. Receiving institutions and auditors can extract the envelope to verify CDD data provenance and retention compliance.

requiredIso20022Fields.notes: Statement identifier — map from KYC record ID
Account identifier for the statement. IBAN preferred.

auditTrailFields.description: The changeLog array in kycProfile.auditMetadata is the primary audit trail source. Each entry documents a material change to the KYC record with timestamp, actor, and description.

retentionCompliance.regulatoryBasis: AMLR Art. 56 — 5-year minimum retention from end of business relationship

screeningCurrency.description: The statement should include the most recent screening results to demonstrate ongoing monitoring compliance (AMLR Art. 21 / FATF Rec. 10).

gdprNotes.description: Statements carrying SAR-linked data must include the gdprSensitivityMetadata block with tippingOffProtected=true. The statement MUST NOT be issued to the account holder in that case.

example: Not provided — camt.053 statements are institution-specific. Use the envelope schema and this profile to construct compliant statements.
